mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the previous 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL annualized increase exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and leads to higher inflation expectations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE is below 5%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% over the previous 3 months signals strengthening demand in the housing sector, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where HOUST increases by more than 10%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% over the previous 3 months signals a weakening supply side, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO decreases by more than 2%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs over the previous month signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 jobs.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow by more than 5% year-over-year and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 6%, it signals strong consumer demand and a healthy labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: strong consumer demand and healthy labor market
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where RSAFS YoY growth exceeds 5% and UNRATE is below 6%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 2% annualized, it signals tightening monetary policy in response to inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is above 2% and CPIAUCSL increases by more than 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% quarter-over-quarter signals a contraction in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 decreases by more than 1% QoQ.
